comparison.why: Unchanged conditional central estimate; newly verified 2026 legal controls strengthen the pathway but not observed exposure/recipient attribution, while explicit shared-cohort and actual-period ledgers correct overlapping/fractional timing sensitivities.

incomePathways.rationale: Joint actual-period resources for explicitly overlapping households. Positive benefits alone are overlap-adjusted; all effort, compliance and displaced-worker losses remain full.
incomePathways.counterfactual: Existing statutory controls, permits, public enforcement and other coalition members without incremental recipient influence.
